description: The pricing owner decides the default, the unknown closes, the decided default is declared, and fresh real-boundary evidence exists for every required obligation.

record.question: What currency do orders without a currency have?

alternatives.description: Orders without a currency read as EUR.
alternatives.consequences: Existing orders need no backfill; readers apply the default.

alternatives.description: Reject every order without a currency.
alternatives.consequences: Existing orders need a backfill before release.
alternatives.rejectedBecause: A backfill of every historical order is not required to meet the pricing change.

record.rationale: Every historical order was priced in EUR.

default.description: An order without a currency reads as EUR, per decision dec.currency-default.

closure.note: Orders without a currency read as EUR.
